defs.def: to agree, often unwillingly, that sth is true （常指勉强）承认

ex.s: Humans are unwilling to admit their shortcomings.
ex.t: 人类不愿承认自己的缺点。

ex.s: Children under 12 years accompanied by an adult are admitted free.
ex.t: 12岁以下由成人陪同的儿童免费入场。

ex.s: Robbie Pruitt admitted that he got 16   when he discovered the theft of his mountain bike last September.
ex.t: 罗比·普鲁特承认去年9月发现他的山地自行车被偷时他很   16   愤怒。

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认自己无法定义时间时，他指出了时间最显著的特性之一：时间只有在特定的语境中才有意义。任何计时系统都是有效的，而每一种都因其用途而值得称赞。

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

ex.s: In that sense, I’m pretty sure volunteering is more of a selfish act than I’d freely like to admit.
ex.t: 从这个意义上说，我很确定志愿服务比我愿意承认的更像是一种自私的行为。

ex.s: Later they all admitted they'd felt cold water at first．
ex.t: 后来他们都承认一开始感觉到的是冷水。

ex.s: Benjamin was forced to admit what he had been doing.
ex.t: 本杰明被迫承认他一直在做的事情。

ex.s: I tried to think of some words of sympathy, but I had to admit that the Rainbow Bookstore couldn’t stay in business much longer.
ex.t: 我试着想了一些同情的话，但我不得不承认，彩虹书店不能再做生意了。

ex.s: Popkid I admit that more advanced AI could be helpful in solving the world’s problems, but there is a high level of risk involved.
ex.t: Popkid我承认，更先进的人工智能可能有助于解决世界问题，但所涉及的风险很高。

ex.s: One day I got word that he was admitted to hospital for a serious disease.
ex.t: 有一天我得知他因重病住院。

defs.def: to say that you have done sth wrong or illegal 承认（过错、罪行）；招认；招供

ex.s: You admit that you were “letting off steam”.
On the whole, I do have to admit that here, people’s knowledge of Chinese literature is rather limited.
ex.t: 总的来说，我不得不承认，在这里，人们对中国文学的了解相当有限。

ex.s: More research is needed to see if improved fitness could have a positive effect on the risk of dementia and also to look at when during a lifetime a high fitness level is most important. " She also admitted that a relatively small number of women were studied, all of whom were form Sweden, so the results might not be applicable to other groups.
ex.t: 需要开展更多的研究，以了解改善健康状况能否对痴呆症的风险产生积极的影响，并审视在一生中，高水平的健身水平何时最为重要。 " 她还承认，研究的妇女人数相对较少，她们都是瑞典人，因此研究结果可能不适用于其他群体。

defs.def: to allow sb/sth to enter a place 准许进入（某处）
to allow sb to become a member of a club, a school or an organization 准许 … 加入（俱乐部、组织）；接收（入学）
to take sb to a hospital, or other institution where they can receive special care 接收入院；收治
